dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature, fitting a non-linear spline with significant inward deviation between the apex and the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point is classified as rounded with an obtuse pixel radius, showing no acute angular termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin follows a convex contour with a moderately steep incline relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 1.7:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, circular white spots or lesions are visible on the lower posterior region of the fin and the adjacent dorsal surface. A faint, irregular white marking is visible on the lower anterior portion of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific cluster of approximately nine distinct white circular points located near the trailing edge base.
